What We Do!

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.27.4″ text_font=”Work Sans|600|||||||” text_text_color=”#FFFFFF” text_font_size=”16px” text_line_height=”1.4em” custom_margin=”50px||50px||true” locked=”off” global_colors_info=”{}”]

At McQuage Security and Electronics, we understand that peace of mind starts with knowing your space is secure. That’s why we offer professional alarm system installations tailored to fit your property and lifestyle. Whether you’re protecting a home, office, or retail space, we design and install systems that work seamlessly in the background—keeping you safe without getting in the way.

Our alarm solutions are built with today’s technology in mind, offering features like instant alerts, remote control access, and optional 24/7 monitoring. We make the installation process smooth from start to finish and ensure you feel confident using your system before we leave.

Security shouldn’t be complicated. With McQuage, you get a system that works when it matters most, installed by a team that puts your safety first.
